item.title: Optogenetics wins the Nobel – one neuroscience breakthrough in a line of technological innovations helping scientists map and control the brain
item.description:
Optogenetics is illuminating the inner workings of the brain. akinbostanci/iStock via Getty Images Plus The brain is unbelievably complicated, which is both daunting and fascinating for neuroscientists like me . In the space of a cubic millimeter – about the size of a single poppy seed – there are tens of thousands of neurons and other brain support cells , all influencing each other’s function. How do neuroscientists make sense of this complexity? And how did they get to the point where they could simply shine different colors of light on the brain to control neuron activity? The answer is one step at a time, with a lot of help from technology. Revisiting some of the technological advances that have supported researchers’ current understanding of how the brain works can point to where the field of neuroscience might be going next. There is a rough pattern to the technological advances…

item.title: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor takes legal action against police and Old Bailey over Epstein raids
item.description:

A private high court hearing is scheduled to take place before Mr Justice Hilliard on Thursday to determine whether documents related to the former Duke of York’s call for a judicial review can be made public, with Thames Valley police and the central criminal court of England and Wales in opposition. item.title: Washington Capitals captain Alex Ovechkin says he'll retire at the end of his 22nd season
item.description:
Alex Ovechkin announced on Monday ahead of the Washington Capitals home opener against the Pittsburgh Penguins that this season will be his last in the National Hockey League. The 41-year-old signed a one-year contract during the offseason to return to Washington for what is his 22nd season in the NHL , all of which he has spent in the nation's capital. In a statement shared by the organization, Ovechkin explained that he had come to the decision to retire during the summer. item.title: Trump says 'threat' led US to pull bombers from RAF Fairford
item.description:
The US withdrew its bombers from RAF Fairford after an investigation into an alleged planned terrorist attack on the base. At least 10 B-1 bombers used by the US military in the Iran conflict flew out of Fairford on Sunday, suggesting US officials were taking the threat seriously. Last week, five men in three vans near the military base were arrested, followed by a sixth British-Iranian national. All were released on bail, drawing criticism from the Pentagon. Lucy Hough speaks to Dan Sabbagh, the Guardian’s defence and security editor – watch on YouTube Continue reading...
